title: svglib nested SVG references can exhaust rendering resources
summary: svglib expands nested SVG use references without a total expansion limit. Small untrusted SVG documents can consume excessive CPU and memory during rendering, including through xhtml2pdf.

severity.rationale: Attacker-controlled documents can exhaust a rendering worker without special options. The documented impact is denial of service, rather than code execution or credential exposure.

affected.note: The advisory lists versions through 2.3.0 as affected.

exposure: Workflows rendering untrusted SVG with svg2rlg are exposed. xhtml2pdf also reaches this dependency when converting HTML containing embedded SVG images.

remediation.details: Install svglib 2.3.1 or later in the environment used for conversion.
remediation.risk: Low. Check representative SVG and PDF output for compatibility.

verification: Confirm the converter resolves svglib 2.3.1 or later; render a normal SVG and check its output.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record from directly inspected primary sources; independent review pending.
